turns.question: Which call topic had the highest objection rate in September 2026, and what was that rate?
turns.answer: Returns had the highest objection rate in September 2026 (1-30 Sep) at 72.7% of labelled calls with an objection, ahead of product at 50.0%; delivery and pricing came back with no value, so they could not be ranked. This is a model-derived label (gemini-3.5-flash, prompt v1). Late: call_transcripts.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
